name: 図形の比率を数で入力
prompt:
Redesign the existing Japanese ratio-entry exercise as a clean 390 × 760 px portrait component. Use the native preview as the authoritative content, component geometry and current input state; use the original Duolingo screenshot as source context, not as a source for Lighthouse colors. Return only the component canvas, with no phone frame or app chrome.

The user explicitly dislikes tint colors. Use a pure-white #FFFFFF canvas and keep every surface white: no mint or pastel fill behind the keypad, hint button, input, keys or shape squares; no tinted backgrounds, gradients, colored shadows or glow. Keep quiet neutral #E4E4E4 outlines and readable #1D1D1D text. Do not add rows, labels, metrics, progress, correctness feedback or other content.

Preserve the existing geometry and state:
- At x=16, y=8, keep “図形の数の比率を答えてください” in Meiryo Bold 20 px / 28 px.
- Show three rows of shapes at y=118, 160 and 202. Each row has one 28×28 square at x=154 and one 32×28 triangle at x=210. Fill every square pure white with a fine forest-green #1F6444 outline; fill every triangle solid forest green. Keep the shapes themselves distinct and clear; do not use pale green fills or add labels.
- Keep the ratio input at x=16, y=320, 358×62, white with a fine neutral border. Display the current answer exactly as “3：3” in dark ink, Meiryo Bold 20 px / 28 px.
- At y=404, keep a 44×44 hint control at x=16, with a white surface, fine neutral outline, and one restrained slate #526173 “？” glyph. Keep the primary button at x=72, y=404, 302×44, solid forest green #1F6444 with the white label “答えを確認する” in Meiryo Regular 14 px / 24 px. Use no pale tint or gradient.
- The keypad spans the bottom area beginning at y=466, on the same white canvas. Keep its 3-column grid with white 114×54 keys and fine neutral outlines. Rows begin at y=480, 546, 612 and 678. The labels, in order, are 1, 2, 3 / 4, 5, 6 / 7, 8, 9 / ：, 0, 消す. Use Meiryo Bold 20 px / 28 px and dark ink. The colon key is the current selected/focused key, so keep only that key solid forest green with a white colon; this is a real state, not a decorative tint. All other keys remain white.

Match the native component's alignment, spacing, proportions, corner radii and typography. The source has cyan/blue accents and bright green; the current Lighthouse mock uses forest green but adds pale mint surfaces. Retain forest green for the main action, selected colon key and square/triangle diagram; neutralize every tint fill. The diagram’s geometry already distinguishes the two shape groups, so do not add blue or a second decorative color. Preserve all visible Japanese text and the exact “3：3” state. Keep the surface calm and high contrast, with no invented game chrome or extra decoration.
reviewNotes: Pure-white page, white keypad and hint surfaces, white square interiors, neutral outlines; no tint fills. Correct full-width answer 3：3 rendered as spaced ASCII and slightly low vertical anchors in one correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Authoritative Japanese component layout, text, current 3：3 entry and active colon-key state. Use as primary reference while removing tint fills.
Original Duolingo ratio exercise screenshot; content and original color-use context only.
Owner-approved restrained green-on-white heading accent; do not borrow tinted areas from other style examples.
